_about: William Cranston Lawton (1853-1941), Professor of Greek at Adelphi College, raw IA OCR of Introduction to Classical Latin Literature (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1904; US public domain by date). Latin literary history (lane B, round dy: fifth IA subject sweep). No uids minted. Round dz (2026-10-23), raw IA: Art and Humanity in Homer (1896), The Successors of Homer (the epic cycle, Hesiod, the Homeric Hymns; IA dates it 1898), Introduction to Classical Greek Literature (1903) and Ideals in Greek Literature (Chautauqua, 1905). His American-literature books and The Soul of the Anthology (1923, not yet checked) are not taken.
